meta.description: A member-based council formed in Iraq to grow trade, investment and lasting partnerships between Iraqi and British companies.

hero.title: Where Iraqi enterprise meets British business
hero.sentence: A member-based council building trade, investment and lasting partnerships between Iraq and the United Kingdom.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: The Iraqi–British Business Council brings Iraqi and British companies together. Formed officially in Iraq, it is a bridge between the two business communities, and it works to open doors for its members to partners, investors and markets in both countries.

visionMission.title: Vision and mission
visionMission.vision: To be the leading bridge for trade and investment between Iraq and the United Kingdom.
visionMission.mission: To connect Iraqi and British companies and help them grow, through introductions, access to markets and practical support.

whyIraq.title: Why Iraq
whyIraq.lede: Sectors where British expertise and investment can work with Iraqi companies on what the country is building next.

meta.title: About the council
meta.description: Who the Iraqi–British Business Council is, its official standing in Iraq and its objectives for Iraqi and British companies.

heading.title: About the council
heading.lede: Who the council is, the official standing it was formed with, and what it works to achieve.

who.title: Who we are
who.p1: The Iraqi–British Business Council is a member-based council that connects Iraqi and British companies. It works for businesses on both sides: Iraqi firms looking for partners, expertise and markets in the United Kingdom, and British firms looking at the opportunities Iraq offers.
who.p2: Because the council was formed in Iraq, its work starts from close knowledge of the Iraqi market: how business is done there, where growth is coming from and what a partner from abroad needs to know before committing.
who.p3: Membership gives a company its place in that network: introductions to the right counterparts, a clearer view of each market, and a council that raises the issues that matter to its members with the bodies concerned.

standing.title: Official standing
standing.body: This standing is the basis of the council's work: companies in both countries deal with a council formed with the approval of Iraqi institutions.

objectives.title: Our objectives
objectives.lede: The six areas of work through which the council serves its members.

heading.title: Membership
heading.lede: Why companies join the council, what membership offers, and how to apply.

whyJoin.title: Why join
whyJoin.intro: Membership places your company in a network of Iraqi and British businesses, alongside a council rooted in Iraq's business community. Whether you are an Iraqi firm looking to grow abroad or a British firm looking at Iraq, the council works to turn that interest into partnerships.

benefits.title: Membership benefits
benefits.lede: What membership gives every company in the council's network.

tiers.title: Membership tiers
tiers.lede: Three tiers, each building on the one before. Choose the one that suits your company and apply; every application is subject to the council's approval.

meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: How the Iraqi–British Business Council collects, uses and keeps the information you send through its contact form and membership application.

heading.title: Privacy policy
heading.lede: How the Iraqi–British Business Council handles the information you give us through this website.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: This website belongs to the Iraqi–British Business Council (IBBC), formed in Iraq with the approval of the Federation of Iraqi Chambers of Commerce, and ratified by the Ministry of Commerce. In this policy, “we” and “the council” mean IBBC.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: We collect only what you choose to send us through the two forms on this site.
The contact form asks for your name, your email address, a subject and your message, and lets you add your company and a phone number.

The membership application asks for your company’s name, sector and country, and for the contact person’s full name, email address and phone number. It lets you add the company’s city, website and size, and the contact person’s position. It also records the membership tier you choose, your agreement to this policy and, if you give them, how you heard about us, a message and a company profile in PDF.
Like any website, the servers that deliver this site may keep standard technical records of each request, such as your IP address and browser type, to keep the site running and secure.

sections.title: Why we use it
paragraphs: We use what you send us only to reply to your message, to consider your membership application and, if it is approved, to manage your membership. We do not use it for advertising and we do not sell it.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your information only as long as we need it to handle your request or your membership.

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We do not share your information with anyone, except where the law requires us to.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: This site does not use cookies for advertising or analytics. It uses only the cookies it needs to work, such as one that remembers the language you chose.

sections.title: Your rights and how to use them
paragraphs: You can ask us what information we hold about you, and ask us to correct it or delete it.
To make a request, write to us through the contact form on this website. We will reply to the email address you give.

meta.title: Terms of use
meta.description: The terms that apply to using the Iraqi–British Business Council’s website and applying for membership.

heading.title: Terms of use
heading.lede: The terms that apply when you use the Iraqi–British Business Council’s website.

sections.title: Use of this site
paragraphs: This website gives information about the Iraqi–British Business Council (IBBC) and lets companies contact the council and apply for membership. By using it, you accept these terms.
Please use the site lawfully. Do not try to disrupt it or reach parts of it that are not public, and do not send anything through its forms that is unlawful, misleading or harmful.

sections.title: Content ownership
paragraphs: The content of this site, including the council’s name and emblem, belongs to the council or its partners unless stated otherwise. The photographs come from free photo libraries, and their rights stay with their photographers.

sections.title: Accuracy
paragraphs: We work to keep the information on this site accurate and up to date, but it is general information only. It is not legal, financial or investment advice, so please take your own professional advice before acting on it. We may correct or change it at any time.

sections.title: Links to other websites
paragraphs: Where this site links to other websites, it does so for your convenience. We do not control those sites and are not responsible for their content or for how they handle your information.

sections.title: Membership applications
paragraphs: Sending a membership application does not make your company a member. Every application is subject to the council’s approval, and the council may accept or decline it.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these terms from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when they last changed, and the version published here is the one that applies.
